entries.zh-CN: 0.6.0 是最后一个支持 macOS 的版本，之后不再提供 macOS 安装包和更新。
entries.en-US: 0.6.0 is the last version that supports macOS. Later versions have no macOS installers or updates.

entries.zh-CN: 使用了“声明产出文件”的交互式工作流，需要 0.6.0 或更高版本才能打开。
entries.en-US: Interactive workflows that declare output files need version 0.6.0 or later to open.

entries.zh-CN: 交互式工作流支持首轮确认、声明产出文件，智能体可以主动报告完成。
entries.en-US: Interactive workflows support first-turn confirmation and declared output files, and agents can report completion themselves.

entries.zh-CN: 从插件市场安装或升级工作流时会报告它依赖的插件；卸载时列出会保留的工作流。
entries.en-US: Installing or upgrading a workflow from the marketplace reports the plugins it needs, and uninstalling lists the workflows that stay.

entries.zh-CN: 工作流画布支持复制粘贴、右键菜单、多选、对齐和定位节点。
entries.en-US: The workflow canvas supports copy and paste, a context menu, multi-select, alignment, and jumping to a node.

entries.zh-CN: 支持显示 CodeAgent 子代理的进度。
定时任务可以交付产物文件。
entries.en-US: Scheduled tasks can deliver artifact files.

entries.zh-CN: 项目文件夹被删除或移动后，会提示缺失的路径并可以重新检查，不再只显示空的模型列表。
entries.en-US: When a project folder is deleted or moved, Ora names the missing path and offers a re-check instead of showing an empty model list.

entries.zh-CN: 恢复的会话首次发送没有得到回复时，会自动重试一次。
entries.en-US: A restored session retries its first message once when it gets no reply.

entries.zh-CN: 在 Windows 上，Skill 文件被占用时会给出更清楚的提示。
entries.en-US: On Windows, Ora explains more clearly when Skill files are in use.

entries.zh-CN: 修复取消重试后，正在查看的对话与历史记录不一致的问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed an open chat disagreeing with its history after a retry was cancelled.

entries.zh-CN: 修复智能体只返回空内容时，工作流节点被误判为完成的问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed workflow nodes being marked complete when an agent returned nothing.
